visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women are sitting side-by-side on a dark grey couch in a brightly lit indoor living room. The woman on the left has long light brown hair and wears a blue-and-white patterned fuzzy sweater, while the woman on the right has long black hair and wears a bright blue cardigan over a white top. Behind them is a large bookshelf filled with books and decorative items. They hold up tablets displaying a 'Disney challenge' prompt. (2) The women hold their tablets forward, showing different Disney male characters. The woman on the left shows Flynn Rider, and the woman on the right shows Prince Eric. They look at each other and smile, gesturing toward their screens. (3) They transition through several visual phases, holding up tablets to show their choices for 'Girl Crush' (Ariel and Elsa), 'Best Love Story' (Live-action Little Mermaid and Tangled), and 'Favorite Dress' (Belle's yellow gown and Ariel's pink dress). (4) The women continue the challenge, showing 'Favorite Companion' (Olaf and Pascal), 'Favorite Villain' (Maleficent and Ursula), and 'Favorite Movie' (Live-action and Animated posters of The Little Mermaid). They laugh and high-five during the movie reveals. (5) In the final phase, they display their 'Hated Disney character' (Darla and the evil stepsisters), pointing at the screens and engaging in a brief animated discussion with hand gestures.
